note: Memory handling: feature matrices are created as disk-backed arrays and standardised in-place in blocks; temporary cache is removed after successful completion. Existing solar/demand-aligned engineered features are retained. Added missing LSTM-aligned 15-minute historical weather context (last 24h), complete 96-step future forecast weather, causal future rolling weather, and full-resolution capacity/calendar trajectories. Future wind speed/direction fields are treated as forecast inputs aligned to each future valid timestamp. They must be forecasts available at the forecast origin, not observed future weather. A single row per valid timestamp does not encode separate forecast vintages for every issue time; use an issue_timestamp/target_timestamp forecast archive for strict vintage-matched operational backtesting. Future capacity mode 'known' assumes the future capacity schedule is known at issue time; use 'persist' otherwise.
